acceptance.durability: SQLite grant/receipt rows and scoped writes commit together; exact retries recheck current credentials and action authorization before receipt replay.
acceptance.accounting: One accepted call, write invocations, distinct affected rows and registered external-outbox cost. Clients cannot choose costs.
acceptance.concurrency: Actual four-process contention on one SQLite database: exactly one accepts and inserts; three receive BUDGET_EXCEEDED. Independent-connection replay is also tested.
acceptance.failure: Caught overspending is latched and rolls back all local writes; callback, async and bounded JSON failures debit nothing. Retained read/write/query methods cannot act after transaction completion.
acceptance.authority: Owner/principal management boundaries, current credentials under the write lock, current action authorization, definition revisions, revoked/expired grants and closed replay.
acceptance.retention: Bounded live grant/receipt admission; owner-scoped terminal retirement after a configured horizon; IDs never reused.
acceptance.transport: Actual MCP server HTTP call and exact retry return one receipt/debit; exhaustion returns a safe tool error.
acceptance.recovery: Actual encrypted SQLite recovery restores an accepted operation boundary with its row, grant debit and receipt; the restored ledger returns that receipt without another debit. Service schema bootstraps before epoch capture. Older restores also restore older revocation state and require current credential/remote-effect reconciliation.

release.scope: Complete release gate against final implementation source with 21 budget tests, followed by all 22 focused tests including the additional encrypted PITR restore/replay case. Final hosted checks exercise the submitted test set.

jsonThenRegressionBefore.scope: An isolated regression against the pre-fix build rejects valid finite JSON with a non-callable then field.

compatibility.publicContract: New opt-in module; existing default calls unchanged.
compatibility.persistentSchema: Additive clank_agent_budget_grants and clank_agent_budget_receipts tables; ordinary backup/recovery capture includes them.
compatibility.rollback: Disable protected actions until the budget adapter is restored. An unbudgeted fallback removes their protection.
compatibility.dependencies: Zero npm dependencies, existing Node/SQLite primitives.
compatibility.distribution: Two additional dist files; explicit 395-file limit, unchanged 6 MiB ceiling.

boundaries.adapter: Identity and management callbacks must use current authenticated server context. Client fields are not credentials. Local writes must use context.db.
boundaries.externalEffects: Count accepted transactional outbox work; use the supplied stable grant/operation ID with an idempotent provider. No exactly-once claim for unrelated network effects.
boundaries.clock: Grant expiry uses the authoritative operator clock; configure and monitor host clock health.
boundaries.roadmap: Feature 16 has local acceptance evidence; seven features implemented and thirty-three remain planned. Hosted checks and protected merge follow.
boundaries.host: Production namespace restrictions and disposable Docker/XFS certification are unchanged.

delivery.review: Author COMMENT review 5464666140; no independent approval claimed; zero unresolved threads.
delivery.merge: Protected squash with expected head; no administrative bypass.
delivery.checkouts: Primary and attached worktree synchronized, preserved untracked hashes unchanged.
